bullets_en: Murmu reshuffles governors, makes some fresh appointments too.
Telangana minister has sought NHAI to expedite expansion of Hyderabad-Vijayawada Highway.
INDIA bloc marches through Delhi, takes SIR protest to SC.
Saudi Energy Minister says attacks testing infrastructure, vows response.
Stop Creating Unrest Among Farmers, Tummala Tells Opposition Parties.
bullets_ur: Murmu ne governors mein radd-o-badal ki, kuch nayi taqarariyan bhi keen.

INDIA bloc ne Delhi mein march kiya, SIR ehtijaj SC tak le gaye.
Saudi Energy Minister ne kaha hamlay infrastructure ka imtehan hain, jawab dene ka azm zahir kiya.
"Kisanon mein be-chaini phelana band karein", Tummala ne mukhalif jamaaton se keh diya.
